blocks.text: The Bangye-ri ginkgo tree, estimated to be around 1,319 years old, was still covered in bright yellow leaves as of Friday afternoon. But strong winds and freezing temperatures the following morning caused most of its leaves to fall between 7 a.m. and 8 a.m., according to Yonhap News Agency. Visitors who witnessed the sudden change described leaves falling like rain, while those arriving later found little more than bare branches. “I arrived around 7 a.m. on Nov. 7 and saw the tree covered in golden leaves.
